message: Year-specific forcing, validation-split dependence, and the conditions under which physics + residual ML beats recalibrated Stefan (covariates, thermal regime, where the physics enters the model, learner)

grid_mm.b_note: b positioned after drawing so that the right end of its direct-label stack sits at right_x (measured shift -1.85 mm)
grid_mm.row_rule: rows 2 and 3 share one category width u (= (right - left - gutter) / (6.2 + 3.2)); c = 6.2 u, d = 3.2 u, e = 4.2 u, f = remainder
grid_mm.x_label_offset_slide_b_mm: slide mode only: panel b x label placed 2.8 mm below the lowest tick label (measured), so the stand-alone b crop has no gap; paper keeps row1 alignment with 'Method' of a

a.filter: scheme block, pair year_obs:clim, featset F8TS, methods P0 P1 Ku D0 R1(lam 0.5, catboost)
a.encoding: ΔRMSE ± 95 % CI, regions offset on x (0.26), region colours, zero line; the only region legend of the figure (above axes); tick labels rotated 40°

b.filter: forcing year_obs, featset F8TS, methods P0(thin grey) P1 D0 R1
b.encoding: slope chart per region over random/block/year/block×year/region on one continuous axis (no axis break); values above 1.3 × max of the non-region splits (direct ML, Lena Delta, region hold-out) are drawn at the top edge as an open marker with the printed value and the line runs continuously to that marker; direct labels (two lines each) at the right end of the last subpanel in text-safe darkened method colours (WCAG ≥ 4.5:1); facet labels in neutral text_aux; where P0 = P1 (region hold-out) the two lines meet at one point (explained in the legend)

c.filter: scheme block, forcing year_obs, ref P1, R1 lam 0.5; modis_v6 preferred; featsets F8 F8T F8TS F8TS_M F8TS_X F8TS_ALL
c.encoding: ΔRMSE ± CI, lines within region, region colours

d.filter: scheme block, forcing year_obs, F8TS, R1 lam 0.5; tdd_bin 0/1/2 = cold/mid/warm

e.filter: scheme block, forcing year_obs, F8TS, ref P1, catboost; methods D0 (direct ML), F1 (physics-input ML), D1 (physics pseudo-labels), R1 lam 0.5 (physics + residual ML)
e.encoding: ΔRMSE ± CI vs recalibrated Stefan, regions offset, region colours, zero line; pseudo-label result ≈ 0 is visible against the zero line

f.filter: scheme block, forcing year_obs, F8TS, ref P1; R1 lam 0.5 filled, D0 open; learners catboost rf mlp tabm ftt
f.encoding: R1 filled, D0 open markers of the same region colour; the only marker legend of the figure (above axes)

shared.y_label_c_e: ΔRMSE vs recalibrated\nStefan (cm) (on c and e; slide crops d, f carry 'ΔRMSE (cm)')
shared.y_range_cd: all CIs of c and d with 5 % pad, nothing clipped, no printed numbers = [-13.3, 15.51] (measured)
shared.y_range_ef: all CIs of e and f with 5 % pad = [-13.12, 4.27] (measured)
shared.legends: region legend once (a), marker legend once (f: filled = physics + residual ML, open = direct ML); b uses direct end labels in method colours, no boxed legend

used_by.deck_spec_v8: R01 ← deck_R01 (fallback __a), R02 ← deck_R02 (fallback __b), R03 ← deck_R03 (fallback __cd), R03b ← deck_R03b (fallback __ef); C01 columns use __a and __c, C02 uses __b

run: OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 nice -n 10 python3 scripts/4_visualization/v7_f4_results_core.py [--slide | --deck]  (CPU only; no CUDA, no soffice)
export: paper: fixed canvas 180 x 199 mm (no bbox tight; margins left 4.1, right 4.0, bottom 2.6, top 2.6 mm, measured); slide: S.export (tight bbox) + panel crops
caption_notes_en: a: region legend applies to a and c–f

b: lines are coloured by method, not by region; at region hold-out recalibrated Stefan has no in-region data to recalibrate and reverts to the source coefficients, so the two Stefan lines meet; open marker with number = value beyond axis range (direct ML, Lena Delta, region hold-out; value from numbers.tex \nrmseLeregDz)

e: physics pseudo-labels ≈ 0 at full labels (reproduce the physical model without adding to it; 
drefLeblkDo, 
drefCablkDo, 
drefAkblkDo); only the residual structure lowers RMSE in the Lena Delta and Canada
f: RF = random forest; MLP = multilayer perceptron; TabM = tabular ensemble MLP; FT-T = feature-tokenizer transformer

deck.mode: RGB, white background, no bbox tight (fig.set_size_inches with +1e-9 in so int(w*dpi) = 3600)

fonts_pt.panel_letter: 14 bold (only when ≥ 2 panels on the slide)

layout_in.note: two-line horizontal tick labels (12 pt) on every slide; ink fills ≥ 95 % of height and ≥ 96 % of width (measured)

slides.R01: panel a alone, axes 1.02–11.88 in × 0.88–4.98 in; methods spread along x (region offset 0.30), two-line horizontal method labels, region legend inside upper-left, y headroom 24 % of span; no panel letter
slides.R02: panel b three slope subpanels (0.84 in left, 1.12 in right for direct labels, 0.50 in gaps); y label once (left), direct labels once (right of last subpanel); no axis break: the Lena Delta direct-ML region value is drawn at the top edge as an open marker with the printed value, line continuous to it; integer ticks (MaxNLocator 7, steps 1·2·5); no panel letter
slides.R03: panels c, d (category width shared) with letters a b; region legend above c; common y range over all CIs of c–d, nothing clipped, no printed numbers
slides.R03b: panels e, f (category width shared) with letters a b; region legend above e, marker legend above f (filled = physics + residual ML, open = direct ML); common y range over all CIs of e–f

qa.paper: PNG inspected at full size: no overlaps or clipping; legends do not cover data; b clipped value printed once (Lena Delta); c–f CIs fully inside the axes
qa.slide: crops a, b, c, d, e, f, cd, ef inspected; b crop gap between tick labels and 'Validation split' removed (2.8 mm)
qa.deck: R01–R03b 3600 × 1530 px, ink fill ≥ 95 % height, ≥ 96 % width (printed by save_deck)

revision: 2026-10-14 review fixes: common right boundary of rows, fixed-canvas export, text-safe label colours, tighter c–e range with clipped values, slide-only y labels, integer ticks, symmetric 4 mm margins | 2026-10-14 (evening) deck mode: panel drawers factored into draw_a…draw_f shared by paper/slide/deck; P0 ring markers in b removed | 2026-10-15 revision v8: b without axis break (clipped open marker + value, continuous line); new panel e (model structure D0/F1/D1/R1 − P1); legends reduced to one region legend (a) and one marker legend (f); rows c·d and e·f with un-clipped CI ranges (no printed CI numbers); deck R03 = c·d, R03b = e·f; canvas 180 × 199 mm | 2026-10-15 review fixes: pages index and deck_spec fallbacks → __cd / __ef, R03b page added; v7 Figure 4 legend (a–f) written in legends.tex; slide-mode b x-label measured (no gap in the b crop)
